# summon.guide

> Every legend who ever lived, on call. Type in any life problem and summon.guide
> matches you with a deeply-researched historical guide, grounded in real
> biographies and primary sources, for streaming chat counsel on your hardest
> decisions. Includes a voiceover tool that turns a short essay into a
> 90-120 second MP3 in a guide's voice, ready for video.

## What it is

summon.guide is a mentorship product for founders and operators facing lonely,
high-stakes decisions, plus creators who want essay-to-voice for video. Each
guide (Rockefeller, Jobs, Bezos, Musk, Huang, Thiel, Munger, Franklin, Walton,
Naval, and others) is grounded in cited biography knowledge chunks, not a
free-floating persona prompt. Responses cite sources back to the underlying
biography or primary text.

It is not a generic chatbot wrapper, not a therapy or crisis-counseling
product, and not a video generation tool itself (video visuals are handed off
to a separate product, book.movie).

## Pricing

25 free messages, then a founding license of $10 for 100 messages via a live
Stripe payment link on the paywall CTA.

## Key routes

- / — home: search or browse the full roster of guides
- /[figure] — a guide's profile page (e.g. /john-d-rockefeller)
- /chat/[figure] — streaming chat with a guide
- /chat/source/[slug] — chat grounded directly in a specific book's corpus
- /skills — Claude Code skills packaged from these guides' frameworks, installable in a terminal
- /speak — paste an essay, pick a guide, generate a 90-120s MP3 voiceover for video
- /books — books that ground the guides, browsable by title
- /library — knowledge library / episode index
- /watch — video episodes made from the books
